deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

test/kotoba/cofog_test.cljk.reason: The suite opens fixture files by a path relative to the old repository root (test/...). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so each such path names the file where it now lives (lib/kotoba.cofog/test/...). Nothing else in the file changes.
